read.thesis: Emerson raised FY26 adjusted EPS guide to about $6.55 on 7% underlying orders and 28.5% segment margin, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity additions cited, and Ovation lead times now run into 2027–2028.

utilisation.quote: Lead times for the Ovation control system have extended into the period of 2027 to 2028

triggers.label: FY26 adj EPS raised to ~$6.55
triggers.quote: we are raising our adjusted EPS guide to $6.55
triggers.highlight: raising our adjusted EPS guide to $6.55

triggers.label: Ovation orders up 31%
triggers.quote: orders in our Ovation business up 31%
triggers.highlight: orders in our Ovation business up 31%

triggers.label: Price contributed 3 points to growth
triggers.quote: Price contributed 3 points to growth and MRO was 65% of sales

triggers.label: Middle East drag ~$25M per quarter
triggers.quote: the impact in Q3 was about a $25 million headwind compared to our February guidance

guidance.quote: We are guiding 2026 adjusted EPS of approximately $6.55
For the full year, we expect 5% GAAP sales growth and 3.5% underlying sales growth
We still expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of 28%
free cash flow of approximately $3.6 billion
There are no changes to our planned return of approximately $2.2 billion to shareholders
We expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of 28.5% and adjusted EPS of approximately $1.85
we still expect ACV growth of 10%-plus in 2026

red_flags.label: Q3 FCF boosted by tariff refunds and tax timing
red_flags.quote: Cash exceeded expectations due to good operational performance, along with the impact of tariff refunds and the timing of tax payments

red_flags.label: Software margin down on renewal timing
red_flags.quote: Software & Systems margin of 31.8% decreased 30 basis points year-over-year

evasions.quote: we're not going to obviously guide into '27
Obviously, it's a little early to comment yet on 2027.
